event.astana-speech.title: China proposes a Silk Road Economic Belt
event.astana-speech.summary: In a speech at a university in Astana, China's leader proposes jointly building a "Silk Road Economic Belt" of trade and transport links from China through Central Asia to Europe.
event.jakarta-speech.title: China proposes a Maritime Silk Road
event.jakarta-speech.summary: Addressing Indonesia's parliament, China's leader proposes a "21st-Century Maritime Silk Road" of ports and shipping lanes linking China with Southeast Asia, the Indian Ocean and Europe.
event.crimea-sanctions.title: First sanctions over Crimea
event.crimea-sanctions.summary: After a disputed referendum in Crimea, the US and the EU impose asset freezes and travel bans on Russian and Crimean officials; Russia annexes the peninsula the next day.
event.russia-sectoral-sanctions.title: Sectoral sanctions on Russia
event.russia-sectoral-sanctions.summary: After flight MH17 is shot down over eastern Ukraine, the EU joins the US in cutting Russian state banks off from Western capital markets and restricting exports of oil technology and dual-use goods.
event.oil-price-crash.title: Oil price collapses
event.oil-price-crash.summary: OPEC decides not to cut output despite a global glut, and crude prices fall to less than half their mid-2014 level, squeezing the budgets and currencies of oil exporters.
event.silk-road-fund.title: Silk Road Fund set up
event.silk-road-fund.summary: China establishes the $40 billion Silk Road Fund in Beijing to invest in Belt and Road infrastructure, energy and industrial projects.
event.eaeu-launch.title: Eurasian Economic Union launched
event.eaeu-launch.summary: The Eurasian Economic Union of Russia, Kazakhstan and Belarus comes into force, turning their customs union into a single market; Armenia and Kyrgyzstan join during 2015.
event.cpec-launch.title: China–Pakistan Economic Corridor launched
event.cpec-launch.summary: During a state visit to Islamabad by China's leader, the two governments sign 51 agreements that launch the China–Pakistan Economic Corridor, with about $46 billion of planned energy and transport projects.
event.greece-capital-controls.title: Greece shuts its banks
event.greece-capital-controls.summary: With bailout talks broken down and deposits draining, Greece closes its banks and limits cash withdrawals to €60 a day; a third bailout is agreed in August.
event.tenge-float.title: Kazakhstan floats the tenge
event.tenge-float.summary: Kazakhstan's central bank lets the tenge float freely, and the currency loses about a quarter of its value against the dollar in a day, pushing up import prices.
event.aiib-founded.title: Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank founded
event.aiib-founded.summary: The China-proposed Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank formally comes into being, with 57 prospective founding members including India, Russia, Germany and the UK.
event.jcpoa-implementation.title: Iran nuclear deal takes effect
event.jcpoa-implementation.summary: After UN inspectors confirm Iran's nuclear steps, the US and the EU lift nuclear-related sanctions on Iranian oil, banking and shipping.
event.china-railway-express.title: China Railway Express brand launched
event.china-railway-express.summary: China brings its many city-run freight trains to Europe under a single China Railway Express brand; local-government subsidies keep rail freight rates well below cost to fill the trains.
event.turkey-coup-attempt.title: Coup attempt in Türkiye
event.turkey-coup-attempt.summary: A faction of the armed forces tries to seize power; the attempt fails overnight with about 250 people killed, followed by a state of emergency and mass dismissals.
event.cosco-piraeus.title: COSCO takes control of Piraeus
event.cosco-piraeus.summary: China's state shipping group COSCO completes the purchase of a 51% stake in the Piraeus Port Authority, making the port a Belt and Road gateway to Europe.
event.egypt-float-imf.title: Egypt floats the pound and turns to the IMF
event.egypt-float-imf.summary: Egypt lets the pound float on 3 November and it loses about half its value; a week later the IMF approves a $12 billion three-year loan tied to subsidy cuts and tax reform.
event.uzbekistan-opening.title: Uzbekistan begins to open up
event.uzbekistan-opening.summary: A new president takes office after the death of Uzbekistan's first leader and starts reforms: easier borders with neighbours, a convertible currency from 2017 and the phasing out of forced labour in the cotton harvest.
event.first-brf.title: First Belt and Road Forum
event.first-brf.summary: Leaders of 29 countries meet in Beijing for the first Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation, where China pledges about $124 billion in new funding.
event.sco-india-pakistan.title: India and Pakistan join the SCO
event.sco-india-pakistan.summary: At its summit in Astana, the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation admits India and Pakistan as full members, its first enlargement.
event.hambantota-lease.title: Hambantota port leased to China
event.hambantota-lease.summary: Under pressure from its foreign debt, Sri Lanka leases a 70% stake in Hambantota port to China Merchants Port for 99 years for $1.12 billion; the deal fuels a worldwide debate over "debt-trap" lending.
event.btk-railway.title: Baku–Tbilisi–Kars railway opens
event.btk-railway.summary: A rail line from Azerbaijan through Georgia to Türkiye opens, giving the Middle Corridor across the Caspian a direct rail link to Anatolia and Europe.
event.us-leaves-jcpoa.title: US leaves the Iran nuclear deal
event.us-leaves-jcpoa.summary: The US administration withdraws from the nuclear deal and announces that sanctions on Iran will return after wind-down periods of 90 and 180 days.
event.us-china-tariffs-2018.title: US–China tariff war begins
event.us-china-tariffs-2018.summary: The US imposes 25% tariffs on $34 billion of Chinese imports and China retaliates in kind; by September further rounds cover $250 billion of Chinese and $110 billion of US goods.
event.turkish-lira-crisis.title: Turkish lira crisis
event.turkish-lira-crisis.summary: The lira plunges during a diplomatic row in which the US doubles tariffs on Turkish steel and aluminium; at its August low it has lost over 40% of its value since January, driving up inflation.
event.iran-sanctions-snapback.title: US sanctions on Iran return
event.iran-sanctions-snapback.summary: US sanctions on Iran's oil exports, shipping and central bank take full effect; Iran's oil exports and its currency fall steeply.
event.italy-joins-bri.title: Italy signs up to the Belt and Road
event.italy-joins-bri.summary: Italy becomes the first G7 country to sign a memorandum of understanding with China on the Belt and Road Initiative, to concern in Brussels and Washington.
event.second-brf.title: Second Belt and Road Forum
event.second-brf.summary: Leaders of 37 countries attend the second Belt and Road Forum in Beijing, where China promotes green and debt-sustainable projects and launches a green development coalition.
event.pakistan-imf-2019.title: Pakistan turns to the IMF
event.pakistan-imf-2019.summary: Facing a balance-of-payments crisis, Pakistan agrees a $6 billion, 39-month IMF loan that requires tax rises and a market-determined rupee.
event.us-china-tariffs-2019.title: US–China tariffs escalate again
event.us-china-tariffs-2019.summary: Having raised tariffs on $200 billion of Chinese goods to 25% in May, the US adds 15% tariffs on a further $112 billion; China raises tariffs on US goods in response.
event.power-of-siberia.title: Power of Siberia pipeline opens
event.power-of-siberia.summary: Russia starts piping gas to China through the Power of Siberia pipeline under a 30-year, $400 billion contract signed in 2014.
event.wuhan-lockdown.title: Wuhan locked down
event.wuhan-lockdown.summary: China seals off Wuhan, and soon most of Hubei province, to contain a new coronavirus; the disease, later named COVID-19, spreads worldwide.
event.brexit.title: The UK leaves the EU
event.brexit.summary: The United Kingdom formally leaves the European Union; a transition period keeps it in the EU single market and customs union until the end of 2020.
event.khorgos-covid-closure.title: Kazakhstan–China border shut to travellers
event.khorgos-covid-closure.summary: Kazakhstan suspends passenger crossings with China to keep out COVID-19; freight keeps moving through Khorgos and other crossings but slows under new health checks.
event.covid-lockdowns.title: COVID-19 declared a pandemic
event.covid-lockdowns.summary: The World Health Organization declares a pandemic; within weeks much of the world is in lockdown, factories and borders close and world trade falls sharply.
event.ever-given.title: Ever Given blocks the Suez Canal
event.ever-given.summary: The container ship Ever Given runs aground and blocks the Suez Canal for six days, holding up hundreds of ships.
event.b3w.title: G7 launches Build Back Better World
event.b3w.summary: At their summit in Cornwall, G7 leaders launch Build Back Better World, an infrastructure partnership for developing countries widely seen as a response to the Belt and Road.
event.dasu-attack.title: Bus bombing kills Chinese engineers
event.dasu-attack.summary: A bomb attack on a bus taking workers to the Dasu hydropower project in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa kills 13 people, nine of them Chinese nationals.
event.no-new-coal-abroad.title: China stops building coal power abroad
event.no-new-coal-abroad.summary: China's leader tells the UN General Assembly that China will not build new coal-fired power projects abroad and will step up support for green energy in developing countries.
event.small-and-beautiful.title: Belt and Road turns "small and beautiful"
event.small-and-beautiful.summary: At a symposium on the Belt and Road, China's leadership calls for "small and beautiful" projects that improve livelihoods, after years of large loan-financed megaprojects.
event.global-gateway.title: EU launches Global Gateway
event.global-gateway.summary: The European Commission launches Global Gateway, which aims to mobilise up to €300 billion for infrastructure abroad by 2027.
event.kazakhstan-unrest.title: Unrest in Kazakhstan
event.kazakhstan-unrest.summary: Protests over a rise in fuel prices spread across Kazakhstan and turn violent in Almaty; troops from a Russia-led alliance are deployed and more than 200 people are killed.
event.russia-invades-ukraine.title: Russia invades Ukraine
event.russia-invades-ukraine.summary: Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The US, the EU, the UK and Japan respond with sweeping sanctions on Russia and Belarus, and food and energy prices rise worldwide.
event.karachi-university-attack.title: Chinese teachers killed in Karachi
event.karachi-university-attack.summary: A suicide bomber attacks a van at the Confucius Institute of the University of Karachi, killing three Chinese teachers and their Pakistani driver.
event.uflpa-in-force.title: US bars goods made in Xinjiang
event.uflpa-in-force.summary: The Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act, signed in December 2021, takes effect: US customs presume that goods made wholly or partly in Xinjiang involve forced labour and bar them unless shown otherwise.
event.pgii.title: G7 launches PGII
event.pgii.summary: At their summit in Elmau, G7 leaders launch the Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment, which aims to mobilise $600 billion by 2027.
event.pakistan-floods.title: Catastrophic floods in Pakistan
event.pakistan-floods.summary: Record monsoon rains since June leave about a third of Pakistan under water; more than 1,700 people die and some 33 million are affected, with Sindh and Balochistan hit hardest.
event.turkey-earthquake.title: Earthquakes devastate southern Türkiye
event.turkey-earthquake.summary: Two powerful earthquakes strike south-eastern Türkiye and northern Syria, killing more than 50,000 people in Türkiye and leaving millions homeless.
event.iran-joins-sco.title: Iran joins the SCO
event.iran-joins-sco.summary: Iran becomes a full member of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation at a virtual summit hosted by India.
event.pakistan-imf-sba.title: IMF rescue for Pakistan
event.pakistan-imf-sba.summary: With reserves down to about a month of imports and default feared, the IMF approves a $3 billion, nine-month stand-by arrangement for Pakistan.
event.imec.title: India–Middle East–Europe corridor announced
event.imec.summary: At the G20 summit in New Delhi, India, the US, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, the EU, France, Germany and Italy sign a memorandum on a rail and shipping corridor from India through the Gulf to Europe.
event.third-brf.title: Third Belt and Road Forum
event.third-brf.summary: Marking ten years of the Belt and Road, delegations from over 130 countries meet in Beijing; China announces new lending windows and a focus on smaller, greener projects.
event.houthi-attacks-begin.title: Houthis begin attacking Red Sea shipping
event.houthi-attacks-begin.summary: Yemen's Houthi movement seizes the car carrier Galaxy Leader, beginning a campaign of attacks on merchant ships in the Red Sea that it links to the war in Gaza.
event.italy-exits-bri.title: Italy leaves the Belt and Road
event.italy-exits-bri.summary: Italy notifies China that it will not renew its Belt and Road memorandum, making it the only G7 member to have joined and then left.
event.red-sea-diversions.title: Shipping diverts around Africa
event.red-sea-diversions.summary: Major container lines stop sailing through the Red Sea and reroute around the Cape of Good Hope; Suez Canal traffic and Egypt's canal revenues fall by more than half.
event.egypt-ras-el-hekma-imf.title: Gulf and IMF deals for Egypt
event.egypt-ras-el-hekma-imf.summary: After a $35 billion UAE investment deal for the Ras El-Hekma coast, Egypt floats the pound again, raises interest rates sharply and agrees an $8 billion IMF programme.
event.besham-attack.title: Chinese engineers killed near Besham
event.besham-attack.summary: A suicide car bomb hits a convoy near Besham in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, killing five Chinese engineers working on the Dasu hydropower project and their Pakistani driver.
event.belarus-joins-sco.title: Belarus joins the SCO
event.belarus-joins-sco.summary: Belarus becomes the tenth full member of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation at its summit in Astana.
event.karachi-airport-attack.title: Attack near Karachi airport
event.karachi-airport-attack.summary: A suicide bombing near Karachi's international airport targets a convoy of Chinese engineers working on a power project, killing two of them.
event.us-china-tariffs-2025.title: US–China tariffs soar
event.us-china-tariffs-2025.summary: After two 10% increases earlier in the year, the US administration raises tariffs on Chinese goods to 145%; China answers with 125% tariffs on US goods, freezing much bilateral trade.
event.geneva-tariff-truce.title: US–China tariff truce
event.geneva-tariff-truce.summary: After talks in Geneva, both sides cut their new tariffs by 115 percentage points for 90 days, leaving extra US tariffs of 30% and Chinese tariffs of 10%.
